title: Pool, Rooftop Deck, City View, Gym + Gated Garage
description:
Luxury condo w/ Free parking in a garage connected to the building. Private balcony, 2 Beds + Air Mattress. Incredible amenities including a Pool, massive rooftop deck w/ a view of the city & outdoor seating, gym, conference room, 2 different lounges w/ a kitchen in one, pool table + more! You cannot beat this famous Music Row location - walk past recording studios on your way to coffee, shopping, restaurants, & live music. Only 2 miles to Downtown Broadway bars & 0.5 mi to Belmont & Vanderbilt!

The space
HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ Located on legendary Music Row, steps from historic recording studios and live music venues 
★ 2 miles to Broadway bars 
★ 2 Beds + Air Mattress 
★ 1 Bedroom
★ 1 Full Bathroom w/ two sinks
★ Pool 
★ Massive rooftop deck with outdoor seating and stunning views of the city
★ Rooftop lounge with a pool table, kitchen, and business center 
★ Front-desk assistance during daytime hours
★ Gym with treadmills, ellipticals, rower, stationary bike, and free weights 
★ Secure building with key code entry required
★ Walk to incredible restaurants, bars, coffee shops and shopping 
★ Additional lounge area on first floor of building
★ Entire condo furnished with thoughtful decor for maximum comfort 
★ Private balcony off the kitchen, overlooking the pool, with seating
★ Parking (unassigned) in a secure garage connected to the condo building 
★ High-speed WiFi 
★ Easy elevator access 
★ HD Smart TV with all the apps in the living room and bedroom 
★ Washer and Dryer in the condo 
★ Central AC + Heat 
★ Keypad entry (no keys to worry about) 
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs 
★ Coffee machine + coffee provided 
★ Quiet location yet convenient access to nightlife 
★ Full-length mirror 
★ Near Vanderbilt, St. Thomas and Centennial Hospitals 

This condo is a beautiful and refreshing mix of style + comfort, featuring lots of natural light. Our private patio is the perfect place for you to plan your adventures in Nashville over your morning coffee. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with your ease + convenience in mind. High-quality mattress + bedding, tasteful elements incorporated throughout, and plenty of space. This upscale condo, with a ton of incredible amenities, will allow you to rest and relax after an adventurous day exploring Nashville.

BEDS:
Bedroom 1: King bed
Living Room: Queen Pullout Couch + Air Mattress

BATHROOM:
Full size with a shower/tub combo and two sinks, connected to Bedroom 1

Guest access
You'll have the entire condo to yourself! The rooftop deck, lounges, conference room and gym are shared building amenities that you will have access to.

Other things to note
Parking in the garage is unassigned and on a first-come, first-serve basis. Additional free street parking also available. The Pool is open seasonally. It is up to our HOA to determine when it closes and opens each year. We are located right by the pool, so some noise is to be expected.

There is construction happening at a building nearby.

Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
